en.title: EU's Kallas accuses Russia of pretending to negotiate on Ukraine while bombing civilians
en.dek: EU foreign policy chief Kallas says Russia pretends to negotiate while bombing Ukrainian civilians.
facts: EU foreign policy chief Kallas accused Russia of pretending to negotiate on Ukraine while bombing civilians.
The statement was reported by Reuters on November 9, 2026.
Kallas stated that Russia is 'pretending' to negotiate while 'bombing civilians'.
The remarks were made regarding the ongoing conflict in Ukraine.
Reuters is the outlet that reported Kallas's statement.
body: EU foreign policy chief Kallas accused Russia of pretending to negotiate on Ukraine while bombing civilians. Reuters reported the statement.
Kallas stated that Russia is 'pretending' to negotiate while simultaneously 'bombing civilians.' The remarks concern the ongoing conflict in Ukraine.
en.context: The statement was made regarding the conflict in Ukraine.

de.title: EU-Außenpolitische Chefin Kallas wirft Russland vor, vorzutäuschen zu verhandeln, während Zivilisten bombardiert werden
de.dek: EU-Außenpolitische Chefin Kallas behauptet, Russland tue so, als verhandle es, während ukrainische Zivilisten bombardiert werden.
facts: EU-Außenpolitische Chefin Kallas warf Russland vor, vorzutäuschen zu verhandeln, während Zivilisten bombardiert werden
Die Äußerung wurde von Reuters am 9. November 2026 berichtet
Kallas erklärte, Russland tue so, als verhandle es, während es Zivilisten bombardiere
Die Bemerkungen bezogen sich auf den anhaltenden Konflikt in der Ukraine
Reuters berichtete über Kallas' Aussage
body: EU-Außenpolitische Chefin Kallas wirft Russland vor, vorzutäuschen zu verhandeln, während Zivilisten bombardiert werden. Reuters berichtete die Äußerung.
Kallas erklärte, Russland verhandle nur vorgetäuscht, während es gleichzeitig Zivilisten bombardiere. Die Bemerkungen beziehen sich auf den andauernden Konflikt in der Ukraine.
de.context: Die Äußerung erfolgte im Zusammenhang mit dem Konflikt in der Ukraine.

fr.title: Kallas accuse la Russie de simuler des négociations sur l'Ukraine tout en bombardant des civils

facts: Kallas accuse la Russie de simuler des négociations sur l'Ukraine tout en bombardant des civils
La déclaration a été rapportée par Reuters le 9 novembre 2026
Kallas a déclaré que la Russie « simule » la négociation tout en « bombardant des civils »
Les remarques portent sur le conflit en cours en Ukraine
Reuters est le média qui a rapporté la déclaration de Kallas
body: Kallas accuse la Russie de simuler des négociations sur l'Ukraine tout en bombardant des civils. Reuters a rapporté cette déclaration.
Kallas a déclaré que la Russie simule les négociations tout en bombardant simultanément des civils. Ses propos concernent le conflit en cours en Ukraine.
fr.context: La déclaration a été faite concernant le conflit en Ukraine.

Kallas afirmó que Rusia está "fingiendo" negociar mientras "bombardea a civiles".

Reuters es el medio que informó la declaración de Kallas.
body: Kallas acusó a Rusia de fingir negociar sobre Ucrania mientras bombardea a civiles. Reuters informó la declaración.
Kallas afirmó que Rusia está "fingiendo" negociar al mismo tiempo que "bombardea a civiles". Los comentarios se refieren al conflicto en curso en Ucrania.
es.context: El comunicado se realizó respecto al conflicto en Ucrania.

it.title: Kallas accusa la Russia di fingere di negoziare su Ucraina mentre bombarda civili

facts: Kallas ha accusato la Russia di fingere di negoziare su Ucraina mentre bombarda i civili.

Kallas ha affermato che la Russia "finge" di negoziare mentre "bomba i civili".

body: Kallas accusa la Russia di fingere di negoziare su Ucraina mentre bombarda civili.
Kallas ha affermato che la Russia sta 'fingendo' di negoziare mentre contemporaneamente 'bomba i civili'. Le dichiarazioni riguardano il conflitto in corso in Ucraina.
it.context: La dichiarazione è stata fatta riguardo al conflitto in Ucraina.

pt.title: A alta representante da UE para os Negócios Estrangeiros acusa a Rússia de fingir negociar sobre a Ucrânia enquanto bombardeia civis
pt.dek: Kallas, alta representante da política externa da UE, afirma que a Rússia finge negociar enquanto bombardeia civis ucranianos.
facts: Kallas acusou a Rússia de fingir negociar sobre a Ucrânia enquanto bombardeia civis.

body: A alta representante da UE para os Negócios Estrangeiros, Kallas, acusou a Rússia de fingir negociar sobre a Ucrânia enquanto bombardeia civis. A Reuters divulgou o comunicado.
Kallas afirmou que a Rússia está a "fingir" negociar ao mesmo tempo que "bombardeia civis". As declarações dizem respeito ao conflito em curso na Ucrânia.
pt.context: O comunicado foi feito no âmbito do conflito na Ucrânia.

zh.title: 卡拉斯指责俄罗斯在轰炸平民的同时假装就乌克兰问题进行谈判
zh.dek: 欧盟外交政策负责人卡拉斯称，俄罗斯假装谈判的同时轰炸乌克兰平民
facts: 欧盟外交政策负责人卡拉斯指责俄罗斯在轰炸平民的同时假装就乌克兰问题进行谈判
该声明由路透社于2026年11月9日报道
卡拉斯表示，俄罗斯“在假装谈判的同时‘轰炸平民’”
这些言论涉及关于乌克兰持续冲突的问题
路透社是报道卡拉斯声明的媒体
body: 卡拉斯指责俄罗斯在轰炸平民的同时假装就乌克兰问题进行谈判。路透社报道了该声明。
卡拉斯表示，俄罗斯在“谈判”之际“轰炸平民”。这些言论涉及乌克兰冲突的持续情况。
zh.context: 该声明涉及乌克兰冲突

ko.title: EU 외교·안보 정책 수장 카라스, 러시아가 우크라이나 민간인 폭격하면서 협상 위장 비난
ko.dek: 카라스 EU 외교·안보 정책 수장이 러시아가 우크라이나 민간인을 폭격하면서 협상을 위장하고 있다고 비판
facts: EU 외교·안보 정책 수장 카라스가 러시아가 우크라이나 민간인을 폭격하면서 협상을 위장하고 있다고 비난
성명서는 로이터통신에 의해 2026년 11월 9일에 보도됨
카라스가 러시아가 '협상을 위장한다'며 '민간인을 폭격한다'고 밝힘
해당 발언은 우크라이나 분쟁과 관련하여 제기됨
로이터통신이 카라스의 발언을 보도함
body: EU 외교·안보 정책 수장 카라스가 러시아가 우크라이나 민간인을 폭격하면서 협상을 위장하고 비난했다. 로이터 통신이 보도했다.
카라스는 러시아가 ‘협상을 위장한다’면서 동시에 ‘민간인을 폭격한다’고 주장했다. 이러한 발언은 우크라이나 분쟁과 관련해 관심을 끌고 있다.

problemsFixed: Facts 4 and 5 in the 'facts' array are unsupported by the provided sources. The sources contain no information about 'ongoing tensions' as a general state or 'continued diplomatic efforts' beyond the specific claim. Fact 2 ('November 9, 2026') is an invented date not present in the source text. The 'context' field references general war context not found in the sources. The body paragraph 2 contains the unsupported claim that 'Both military actions and negotiation efforts persist,' which is a vague inference not directly sourced. The dek is overly evaluative ('accuses... while bombing'). The headline is acceptable but needs verification against the 90-char limit and neutrality check.
